title: Taiwan's vice president calls for closer EU ties in rare address to international lawmakers
description: Taiwan's deputy leader, Bi-Khim Hsiao, called on the European Union to strengthen security and trade ties. She urged support for Taiwan's democracy amid growing threats from China. Hsiao highlighted the importance of peace in the Taiwan Strait for global stability. She also advocated for collaboration on trusted supply chains and AI technology.

title: Taiwan VP's Bold European Outreach Amidst Tensions
description: Taiwan Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim made a rare visit to Belgium, addressing lawmakers at the European Parliament as part of Taiwan's efforts to strengthen ties with Europe. Her visit highlights Taiwan's commitment to democracy, despite condemnation from China, which views such interactions as interference.
